provenance.l: ESA ExoMars 2016 Schiaparelli Anomaly Inquiry — entry 14:42:22, chute 14:45:23 (~Mach 2), shield off 14:46:03, backshell released early 14:46:49, thrusters 3 s at ~3.7 km, impact 14:47:28 (~150 m/s): an IMU saturation left the attitude ~165° wrong and the radar altitude read negative. 577 kg, 2.4 m shield, 12 m DGB chute
Schiaparelli EDM crash reconstruction — ESA ExoMars 2016

Schiaparelli failure (docs/wip/2026-11-23-mars-landings-record.md, ESA investigation): an IMU saturation released the chute and backshell early, at about 3.7 km; the thrusters fired 3 s instead of 30 s; about 40 s of free fall; impact at about 150 m/s
